images.alt: Graphic square tile with a blue gradient background displaying bold white text that reads 'HIV Monitoring Report' and below it 'Now published'. Bottom left corner shows Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo, and bottom right features the Ministry of Health (Manatū Hauora) logo.

post.text:
Today, on World AIDS Day, we mark a major milestone in New Zealand’s HIV response. 

The first HIV Monitoring Report has been published, tracking progress toward the ambitious goals of the National HIV Action Plan 2023–2030.  

Read the full report and media release below.
